hook: Do you feel tired all the time? Your body might be missing iron!
caption:
Day ki saripoye energy lekunda roju alaasata ga untunda? Idi iron deficiency lakshanam kavachu! 🌸 Palakoora, danimma pandlu, kharjooram lanti iron-rich foods manam roju tineti aaharamlo include cheyadam chala mukhyam.

poster_caption:
Struggling with low energy and brain fog? It might not be lack of sleep—it could be a hidden iron deficiency! 🩸✨

Here is how to fix it:
• Know your sources: Animal heme iron absorbs directly, while plant non-heme iron needs an acidic activator.
• Supercharge absorption: Always pair plant-based greens with fresh citrus (Vitamin C) to boost uptake by up to 300%.
• Avoid iron blockers: Keep coffee, tea, and calcium away from your iron-rich meals by at least 60 minutes.
